verdict.rationale: LiveKit documents two narrow, built-in event-triggered behaviors. Telephony dispatch rules route inbound callers to rooms, and auto-egress starts recording automatically when a room is created. These are first-party rule-to-action mechanisms, but they are fixed to specific use cases rather than a general rules engine. Missing for 10: general-purpose user-defined event→action rules, a broad event catalog, conditional logic or chaining across arbitrary events, any detailed documentation of rule configuration, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: All callers can be placed in the same room or different rooms based on the dispatch rules.
